Physical lengths must stay nonnegative on reversed coordinate steps; added absolute values.

Remainder argument now uses bounded displacement/time ratio and explicitly handles zero displacement; avoids claiming proportional nonzero motion.
Moved checkpoint after the variables, diagram and formulas it asks students to read.

Failure of Riemann integrability need not cause oscillation in every cell. Replaced by area-weighted oscillation-sum criterion and distinguished small bad sets.
Average-value definition now requires an integrable function and finite positive area.
Explained that the two closed L-shape rectangles differ from the setminus description on zero-area boundary segments only.
Concentration comparison example now assumes continuity/local integrability rather than deducing Riemann integrability from an integrable upper bound.
Restored nonnegative/absolute-convergence restrictions in improper-integral summary; replaced hardcoded Problem10 with semantic xref.

Replaced unquantified near-surface conclusion from one half-size cube by explicit fixed-distance-to-face fraction(1-epsilon)^n and checked optional solution.
Corrected volume grows like rho² to thin-shell volume per unit radial thickness grows like rho².
Specified centimeter coordinates and mass72 grams in gel-block example.
Qualified universal assertion that cylindrical coordinates solve every axis-organized problem.
Clarified injectivity on the interior versus permitted boundary repetitions; crease splitting uses smooth branch extensions that satisfy theorem's open-neighborhood hypotheses.
Clarified interior injectivity versus boundary repetition in spatial substitution theorem.
Warning example formerly inferred availability of dPhi merely from existing partials. Added |Phi|<=|xy|<=r²/2 proving total differentiability and exactness at origin while coefficients lack C1.
Average along curve now requires finite positive length and continuous integrand. Supplied harmonic-series lower-bound explanation for infinite-length oscillatory curve.
Removed misleading distrust of dot product; checkpoint now asks why the metric factor makes dot product and form calculations agree.
Fixed a the constant curve typo.
Defined pivots in echelon form, avoiding apparent identification of arbitrary leading entries with independent pivot columns.
Reference change-of-variables formula now cites its global hypotheses and uses explicit T* for oriented area rather than equating forms on distinct domains.
Restricted direction-language to real eigenvectors/eigenvalues; specified positive integer powers. Summary now states nonzero eigenvectors, full basis, symmetric positive-definite setting.

Distinct coordinate pairs represent the same point; replaced literal tuple equalities by defined equivalence relation. Added nonnegative radius and quadrant/axis-safe angle recovery; relabeled general integral as integral, not area.
Added nonnegative radius and sine/cosine angle recovery including x=0; tangent shorthand now correctly limited and quadrant-qualified.
Explained appendix variable order(rho,phi,theta) versus reversed angular order and sign. Added radius/inclination recovery, axis-safe azimuth and away-origin cone equation scope.
